gates.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
gates.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. Reinstall after a manifest change so the new scopes are granted. This app creates the workspace, invites users, and stages channels. People do not message it.

gates.title: Store the org-admin Slack token
gates.detail: Keep the org-admin user token in the coding agent's secret store as SLACK_ADMIN_TOKEN. Set SLACK_PLUS_EMAIL to the inbox that should receive every invite, and the seeder invites each person as that address with a plus tag. Persona tokens use SLACK_TOKEN_LINNEA, SLACK_TOKEN_ASTRID, SLACK_TOKEN_HENRIK, and the same pattern for Johan, Erik, Sara, Nils, Maj, and Alva. The agent uses them to create the workspace and post the staged lines. Keep them out of git. Skip a token when it is already stored.

gates.title: Make Linnea a Frontline Member
gates.detail: Turn on the Frontline add-on. Linnea is a Frontline Member with exactly #store-uppsala, #region-mitt, #food-safety, #announcements, and #onboarding, and she is out of #general and #random. Astrid and Henrik are Full Members. Henrik is in every store channel. Every other speaker is a Full Member too. Create an @facilities user group. Use separate Chrome profiles for Astrid and Henrik, and test phone mirroring for Linnea. Do this before the webinar. The live demo does not include an admin invite.

gates.title: Build the workflows and test them on a phone
gates.detail: In Workflow Builder, create Complete my induction, Report an issue, and End-of-shift handover from the forms in the plan, and bookmark each one in its channel. Create Acknowledge as a one-tap workflow and put that link on the price-change button. Test all four as Linnea on a phone, and open the onboarding canvas on that phone. Then re-run the seed so the bookmarks and the button use those links.

gates.title: Post any staged lines the tokens did not send
gates.detail: Each staged message is posted as that person. Where a persona token is missing, sign in as that person and paste the line from the dry-run. Leave Linnea's fridge 4 reply unsent until Astrid has replied in the thread. Put the fridge 4 photo in Linnea's camera roll before the webinar.

gates.title: Pre-record Linnea's beat
gates.detail: Record Beat 1 on the phone as a fallback before the webinar. The live path is still Linnea in Slack, with no huddle.
